bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12"x6"x12" are allowed in the venue and will be searched prior to entry. Non-clear bags may undergo additional searches.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking availability, access routes, and pricing at House of Blues Chicago can vary by event. Review the linked official information and reserve in advance when that option is offered.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in House of Blues Chicago's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: House of Blues Chicago offers a Southern-inspired menu with made-from-scratch dishes. Highlights include BBQ nachos, smoked buffalo wings, jambalaya, and a variety of salads and mains like blackened salmon and baby back ribs. The venue also features a selection of burgers and sandwiches.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Limited storage is available for wheelchairs, canes, walkers, and other mobility devices.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in House of Blues Chicago's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at House of Blues Chicago. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at House of Blues Chicago. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
